text:
The shape with three sides is a triangle.

Here is a funny anecdote based on the text:

Chris walked into the gym with the swagger of a man who had just watched one YouTube tutorial on "How to Lift Heavy Things." He approached the new weight machine like it was a wild horse he intended to break, not realizing the machine was actually a trap designed to humble the overconfident. With a dramatic grunt, he locked himself in, only to realize too late that he had become part of the upholstery. There he stood, frozen in an awkward, mechanical hug with the equipment, frantically patting his pockets for a release button that didn't exist. It was the ultimate "man versus machine" battle, except the machine was winning, and the nearby gym-goers were losing their minds trying not to laugh at Chris’s silent scream for help. He didn't just lift weights that day; he lifted the collective spirit of the gym with pure, unadulterated comedy.
